feeds.title: The Charles Smith Blog
feeds.description: The Charles Smith Blog began in 2007 after Charles retired from The Toronto Star. Its main goal was to keep looking into the story of a problematic pathologist and the harm caused to innocent parents, caregivers, and Ontario's justice system. The Blog mainly focuses on cases that raise issues in these areas, especially those involving the death penalty.

feeds.title: Billoblog » Forensic Pathology
feeds.description: Billoblog, by Bill Oettinger, is a blog that covers an array of topics like politics, religion, and culture. In his separate section for pathology, Oettinger shares insights and stories related to pathology, including experiences, medical education, and thoughts on healthcare.

feeds.title: Lablogatory Blog » Forensic Pathology
feeds.description: TheLablogatory Blogfocuses specifically on laboratory medicine. It covers a wide range of topics within this field, including clinical laboratory practices, advancements in diagnostic techniques, discussions on medical tests, updates on laboratory technology, and the role of laboratories in healthcare. Its section for Forensic Pathology shares case studies for learning for the student looking to get into this field, along with feature articles, news and more.

feeds.title: Rob Kurtzman Photography Forensic Pathology Blog
feeds.description: Rob Kurtzman, a forensic expert, has a website around forensic science and related areas. In his Rob Kurtzman Photography Forensic Pathology Blog he shares insights on investigative methods, analysis techniques, case studies, and advancements in forensic technology. His blog provides resources for professionals and students keen on forensic science, potentially including articles, consultancy services, and details about his expertise and background in the field.

feeds.title: Forensic Pathology & Toxicology
feeds.description: This site is intended for those who is in need of services like medico-legal consultation followed by my court appearance as a defense witness. The students may benefit by attending online classes upon request. All the services provided are chargeable.Forensic Pathology & Toxicology offers information about forensic pathology as a profession, detailing its role in investigations, autopsies, and determining causes of death.

feeds.title: Forensic's Blog » Forensic Pathology
feeds.description: Forensic's Blog is a blog dedicated to forensic science, covering investigation techniques, crime scene analysis, technology, case studies, and resources for students and professionals in the field. It's a valuable hub for those interested in forensic science.

feeds.title: The Forensic Doc Blog
feeds.description: The Forensic Doc Blog covers various questions about forensic pathology, diving into complex subjects and concerns with detailed answers. Find the answer to your question! Author and owner Dr. Chundru is a Forensic Pathologist with more than twenty years of experience investigating deaths and serious injuries.
